text:
Sarah (AE): Hey team — kicking off Hooper POC orderflow. They want a 30‑day POC, DPA redlines incoming, and a PO number on the order form. Need signer mapping and eSign path.
Tom (Sales Eng): putting the POC scoping doc here: https://drive.redwood/hooper/poc-scoping (view only for now)
Sarah (AE): @Mike (Legal) @Dani (Legal Ops) they attached a DPA with a data residency addendum. Key asks: HSM/KMS attestation and subprocessor list. Any quick blockers?
Mike (Legal): glanced at the DPA. Two sticky clauses: (1) KMS key control language — they want HSM-backed keys + customer control; (2) 3rd party subprocessors list needs explicit approval for Azure partner.
Dani (Legal Ops): We can offer KMS attestation doc but offering customer-managed keys for Private only. For Hosted/Dedicated we have our KMS. Can we confirm deployment mode for Hooper?
Sarah (AE): They prefer Hosted for first POC (fast), but will consider Dedicated if KMS required.
Tom (Sales Eng): For Hosted we can provide attestation and SOC docs. If they insist on CMK we'll escalate to Dedicated.
Raj (EngSec): Quick note — attestation takes 48–72h to prep. Subprocessor list current as of 2026-03-01: https://internal.redwood/subprocessors. If legal needs signed ack, we can add an addendum.
Dani (Legal Ops): Ok. I'll prepare a DPA mark that replaces 'customer-managed keys' ask with 'KMS attestation + written process' for Hosted POC.
Mike (Legal): Also redline SLA paragraph: they require 99.95 uptime for all inference endpoints during POC. We should limit SLA commitments in POC to 'commercially reasonable efforts' and provide metrics.
Sarah (AE): Hooper's procurement wants the order form to include PO# in the DocuSign envelope, and a dedicated email for accounting.
Anne (Sales Ops): I can generate the order form draft. What signature flow do we want? One central signer (Hooper procurement) + countersign by Redwood Sales Ops?
Tom (Sales Eng): Need signer mapping because the technical contact (ctech@hooper.com) is different from procurement (procure@hooper.com). Mapping: procurement = signer; technical contact = notif only.
Sarah (AE): Correct. Also Hooper asked about a 'split billing' clause — they want to route invoices to a US entity but have EU data residency. Noted.
Dani (Legal Ops): For DocuSign, send single envelope with two roles: "Hooper - Procurement (sign)" and "Hooper - Technical (cc)". Redwood final signer = "Redwood Sales Ops (sign)".
Anne (Sales Ops): I'll create envelope template. Please confirm exact emails.
Tom (Sales Eng): procurement = procure@hooper.com, technical = ctech@hooper.com, accounting = ap@hooper.com (cc).
Sarah (AE): Adding that: ap@hooper.com should be in the envelope as a 'recipient' with 'receive a copy'.
Mike (Legal): Two practical asks before we send: 1) replace absolute SLA promise with runbook/metrics link; 2) add KMS attestation appendix for Hosted. I'll add redlines and send.
Sarah (AE): Great. Can we aim to have redlined DPA + orderform ready by EOD tomorrow?
Dani (Legal Ops): I'll target EOD tomorrow. If we need faster, I'll do a prioritized email thread.
Raj (EngSec): I can draft the KMS attestation (short) and attach the SOC snapshot. ETA tomorrow morning.
esign-bot: DocuSign envelope ready template created by Anne. Template ID: tpl_8a7f9.
Anne (Sales Ops): Draft order form attached: https://drive.redwood/hooper/orderform-draft-v1.pdf — I left placeholders: PO_NUMBER, SIGNER_NAME, BILLING_ENTITY.
Sarah (AE): Sample order form fields (paste):
```
PO_NUMBER: <po_number_here>
TERM: 30 days
MODEL: hosted-standard
BILLING_ENTITY: Redwood, Inc
```
Tom (Sales Eng): Heads up — pricing for hosted-standard POC = $0 for first 30k tokens then $0.0008/token overage. Confirmed with finance.
Sarah (AE): I'll tell Hooper. Also ask them to put PO# onto the envelope before returning.
Mike (Legal): I'll comment inline on the order form re: 'payment net 30' and 'invoice to ap@hooper.com'.
Dani (Legal Ops): Once I post the redlines I'll ping this thread and attach final DPA + signature instructions.
Sarah (AE): Thanks all. Small checklist: (1) Mike/Dani post redlines; (2) Raj upload KMS attestation; (3) Anne create envelope and prefill emails; (4) I'll confirm POC mode with customer.
Tom (Sales Eng): I'm ready to do integration kickstart once signatures complete.
Sarah (AE): Perfect. If anything urgent ping me. :thumbsup:
